name: Profenamine
summary: Profenamine (INN; also known as ethopropazine (BAN); sold under the trade name Parsidol and others) is a phenothiazine derivative used as an antiparkinsonian agent that has anticholinergic, antihistamine, and antiadrenergic actions.

pharmacology.text: Profenamine (INN; also known as ethopropazine (BAN); sold under the trade name Parsidol and others) is a phenothiazine derivative used as an antiparkinsonian agent that has anticholinergic, antihistamine, and antiadrenergic actions.

uses.text: Profenamine (INN; also known as ethopropazine (BAN); sold under the trade name Parsidol and others) is a phenothiazine derivative used as an antiparkinsonian agent that has anticholinergic, antihistamine, and antiadrenergic actions.

sideEffects.en: Common effects include drowsiness, dry mouth, blurred vision, constipation and dizziness. Higher amounts can cause confusion and a fast heartbeat.
sideEffects.zh: 常見副作用包括嗜睡、口乾、視力模糊、便秘和頭暈。較大量可能引起意識混亂和心跳加快。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见副作用包括嗜睡、口干、视力模糊、便秘和头晕。较大量可能引起意识混乱和心跳加快。

fact.en: Although it is a phenothiazine like chlorpromazine, profenamine has little antipsychotic action and was used instead to treat the tremor and stiffness of Parkinson's disease.
fact.zh: 普羅吩胺雖然和氯普麻一樣屬於啡噻嗪類，卻幾乎沒有抗精神病作用，反而被用來治療帕金森氏症的顫抖和僵硬。
fact.zhHans: 普罗吩胺虽然和氯普麻一样属于啡噻嗪类，却几乎没有抗精神病作用，反而被用来治疗帕金森氏症的颤抖和僵硬。
